concerns.text: FR‑001 (load & merge datasets) is not covered – there is no task for downloading the verified pre‑merged `AnalysisDataset` (e.g., T001) nor for schema validation of that file.
FR‑001 also requires CRS detection/reprojection (tasks T004a/T004b) and a merge‑validation step (e.g., T018) to verify match proportion; these tasks are absent.
FR‑002 (summary statistics, correlation matrix, VIF‑pair diagnostics, Moran’s I) has no corresponding tasks – the EDA pipeline (tasks T010‑T015 in the plan) is missing.
FR‑005 (VIF > 5 flagging) is not represented by any task; a VIF‑pair reporting task is required.
FR‑006 (global Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction) is not covered – no task aggregates p‑values or applies the BH procedure (plan tasks T024‑T025c).
SC‑001 (measure proportion of song recordings matched) lacks a verification task (e.g., T018 “Merge Validation”) to compute and record the match rate.
SC‑002 (model R² improvement over null and global F‑test p < 0.05) is not explicitly tested; a task to assert the required improvement and record it is missing.
SC‑004 (VIF threshold > 5 must be flagged) is not verified by any task; a test ensuring VIF diagnostics are performed and reported is needed.
SC‑005 (runtime < 1 h) is only loosely referenced by T041 (runtime < 6 h). A task asserting the 1‑hour limit and failing if exceeded is required.
SC‑003 (Jaccard stability across threshold sweep) is not explicitly covered; a task to compute and validate Jaccard indices between successive predictor sets is missing.
Power analysis (T021) exists, but there is no task to verify that the a‑priori sample‑size calculation is performed and that under‑powered warnings are generated (plan task T016).
Scaffold tasks T002, T003, T005, T007 are present but lack traceability tags linking them to any FR/SC; while not a defect, adding `[FR‑001]` or similar would improve traceability.
